convert_roberta_checkpoint: convert a fairseq RoBERTa checkpoint to a PyTorch HuggingFace model with configurable classification or masked LM head
build_roberta_masked_lm: build a RobertaForMaskedLM model from a fairseq RoBERTa checkpoint by copying and splitting encoder weights
build_roberta_classification: build a RobertaForSequenceClassification model from a fairseq RoBERTa checkpoint using the MNLI classification head
verify_conversion_accuracy: verify the converted model produces outputs matching the original fairseq RoBERTa model within tolerance
run_conversion_cli: run the RoBERTa checkpoint conversion script via argparse CLI with checkpoint path, output path, and optional classification head flag
